Health research saves lives

The Health Research Council of New Zealand is the principal government funder of health research in New Zealand. Our investment improves health outcomes, strengthens the health system and progress towards health targets, and adds value to the nation’s science, innovation and technology system and the wider economy.

  • Visit our dedicated portal, HRC Gateway for information on funding rounds and to apply.

  • Search our research repository for details of HRC-funded studies over the past 10 years.

     

  • Find out more about our funding priorities and how we invest in excellent research.

Latest news

View all

  • Major NZ-led clinical trial to test AI-guided treatment of critically ill patients

    A clinical trial involving 50 hospital intensive care units throughout New Zealand and Australia will test if artificial intelligence can help doctors save more patients’ lives who are on life support. It is one of 40 HRC grants announced today.
    Find out more

  • Health Research Council appoints new Chief Executive

    The Health Research Council of New Zealand (HRC) has appointed Professor Hannah Buckley as Chief Executive.
    Find out more

  • Taurite Tū research team recognised for excellence in eldercare innovation

    The research team from Te Rūnanga o Ōtākou Taurite Tū Limited in Otago have received two awards at the prestigious Asia Pacific Eldercare Innovation Awards in Singapore.
    Find out more

In 2020, we celebrated 30 years of health research achievements.
